scope: Actual chat-tools IIFE, actual gifts rememberChat/captureNavigation/openGiftChat, catalog chatInfo/conversationMessages, lazy demand/close/personDetail and app.save. Controlled minimal DOM, IndexedDB completion, pointer events and microphone permission boundaries. No product edits or browser.

results.name: decimal amount parser accepts positive cents and rejects invalid/unsafe formats
insufficient amount cannot create confirmation transaction
repeated pay debits once with one message and numeric RM ledger
refund is applied once and settled record cannot be claimed again
simulated recipient claim never credits sender and cannot later refund
pay save failure restores complete state and keeps request retryable
retry after failed payment commits one transaction
refund save failure restores wallet ledger and pending message
refund retry still credits once after rollback object replacement
final payment checks latest balance after confirmation
cancelling tool restores same composer node, draft and chat scroll
stale upload after switching chat creates no message in either chat and deletes blob
media message save failure rolls back metadata and deletes committed blob
attachment database failure does not append a message or save state
double attachment submit writes one blob and one metadata message
late microphone permission after leaving stops tracks without recording or message
successful financial send preserves upstream chat return destination
cold profile navigation returns to contact-card detail before chat
late old recording data cannot contaminate the next chat recording
failed call-record save preserves retry and retry appends exactly once
pointer cancellation before hold threshold starts no recording or permission request
release before microphone permission invalidates request and stops late tracks
upward hold cancellation releases recording tracks and ignores final audio chunk
failed text save retains draft and DOM; retry sends once without replacing chat
